reason: Audit decision: accept. V3-08 repair accepted. The candidate repairs the per-relaunch kill loop: after a force-stop (crash detector or stuck detector) + relaunch, the relaunched app needs a fresh cold-start window (documented worst case 240s), but the previous COLD_START_GRACE_MS tied to waitStart has already elapsed, so the stuck-app detector immediately counts empty dumps against the fresh cold start and force-stops again — an infinite kill loop that failed the trusted finalizer emulator E2E step 16 consecutive times. The fix adds FORCE_STOP_RECOVERY_MS = 300s: every force-stop path records globalThis._lastForceStopTime, and stuck detection increments consecutiveEmptyMatchCount only once 300s have elapsed since the last force-stop. Delta confined to scripts/e2e-android.js (+39/−2) and its contract test (+25); no product code (src/, app/) touched — V3-01..V3-07 invariants preserved. Trusted verification exit 0: typecheck PASS, 453/453 tests PASS (22 suites), privacy 71/71 PASS, cost 21/21 PASS, expo export android PASS, prebuild PASS, assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 17m25s. Independent re-runs confirm all gates pass. V3-08 remains in_progress because the trusted finalizer must be re-dispatched to exercise the emulator E2E golden-path step with the per-relaunch recovery fix in place. The trusted shell owns that re-dispatch; the Builder cannot invoke the finalizer directly.
